title: Robert Jr. Probable NDE 8387
content: During my second semester of college, I battled depression due to overwhelmingly stressful circumstances. I was using and abusing many different prescription drugs and drinking very heavily. After a while, my body began to become more and more frail as a side effect to extensive drug use. There was one night that I took it too far. I decided to mix prescription drugs with a half a pint of whiskey. Looking back now, I can see how one would think I was making an attempt on my life but I truly was not. I was depressed, but not suicidal. After about an hour and a half I found myself with very limited consciousness. I was in a dorm room sitting in a rocking chair. My chest began to hurt. I felt like life was shutting down, as if everything that had to do with my external reality was fading. I tried to stand up, but fell to the ground. My friends gathered around me, trying to pick me up. I could hear them calling my name but with every second, their calls become more like echoes in some far away cave. I began to feel like breathing was optional, as if it no longer mattered to me. I felt like I could feel and see everything which was nothing at all. Everything was pure energy. I felt as if I was evaporating into the very air itself. Then I heard a voice, but saw no Being. It asked two questions in this order: 1) 'What are you doing here?'; and 2) 'Do you have any regrets?' To the first question I replied 'I do not know.' To the second question if I had any regrets I answered, 'Yes.' Lying was not an option. I felt an overwhelming sense of peace that I've never experienced in my life. I felt no need to lie, it just wasn't necessary. The voice then told me, 'It is not your time.' Then slowly, I regained consciousness. I was returning. I awoke on the floor in my friend's arms, gasping for air. I was told he slapped me, but I felt nothing. Although my face was red. I was told I was passed out for 10 minutes or so, and that my breathing was becoming more and more faint. They said they were seconds away from calling an ambulance. out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He described an overwhelming peace and a sense of 'evaporating into the very air itself.'

arrival.other_being_detail: He heard an unidentifiable voice but saw no being.

environment.environment_other_detail: He described perceiving 'pure energy' where things had no shapes or parameters, and a 'clearly mystical or unearthly realm' like being 'stitched into the very fabric of the universe itself.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug/medication overdose combined with heavy alcohol use (prescription drugs mixed with half a pint of whiskey).

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Agnostic (religiously unaffiliated) prior to the experience; afterward 'unaffiliated / nothing in particular.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported a 'void' quality and perceiving everything as 'pure energy,' plus hearing an unidentifiable voice asking two questions and stating, 'It is not your time.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He first experienced fading external reality and loss of bodily awareness, then an energy/void-like realm with an unidentifiable voice and a barrier, followed by a gradual return of consciousness into his body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Auditory perceptions described as being 'felt like feelings' and vision described as perceiving only 'matter, like pure energy' without shapes or parameters; the unidentifiable voice asked two direct questions ('What are you doing here?' and 'Do you have any regrets?') before stating, 'It is not your time.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “What are you doing here?” “Do you have any regrets?” “It is not your time.” “I felt as if I was evaporating into the very air itself.” “It felt like being stitched into the very fabric of the universe itself.”
